design.excerpt: This prospective cohort study included 192,428 participants from the UK Biobank, recruited from 2006 and followed until 2023.

timing.excerpt: Follow-up lasted from the date of the last valid 24-hour dietary recall until the first occurrence of cancer, death, or the last follow-up date, whichever came first.

continent.excerpt: The UK Biobank is a large prospective cohort comprising over 502,000 individuals aged 37 to 73 years who were recruited from 22 assessment centers across England, Wales, and Scotland between 2006 and 2010

exposure_measurement.excerpt: Plant protein consumption information was assessed using validated 24-hour dietary recalls.

smoking_status.excerpt: All results were adjusted for age, race, TDI, education level, employment status, BMI, physical activity, smoking status, alcohol consumption, total energy intake, animal protein intake, and diabetes status
